recalls.subject: ADS may not detect heavy smoke in roadway
recalls.summary: Zoox recalled automated-driving software that might fail to recognize heavy smoke and continue into an emergency scene with poor visibility.
recalls.consequence: May increase collision risk in low-visibility emergency scenes.
recalls.remedy: Software update; consult NHTSA campaign record for completion status.

recalls.subject: ADS software may cause lane-line crossings near intersections
recalls.summary: Zoox recalled software that could allow its vehicles to cross lane markings or enter opposing traffic near intersections.

recalls.subject: ADS may not detect people immediately next to the vehicle
recalls.summary: Zoox recalled software that might fail to detect someone standing very close to its vehicle, creating a risk of unexpected movement.
recalls.remedy: Zoox reported implementing the remedy on affected vehicles by May 21, 2025.

recalls.subject: ADS prediction error may prevent avoiding a collision
recalls.summary: Zoox recalled collision-prediction software that could misjudge vehicles emerging from perpendicular driveways, potentially delaying evasive action.
recalls.remedy: Zoox reported updating operating vehicles by April 17, 2025.

recalls.subject: Unexpected hard braking
recalls.summary: Zoox recalled software that could cause sudden, unnecessary braking around cyclists or motorcycles, increasing the risk of rear-end collisions.
